slides.title: Start with what it needs from the phone
slides.body: If a browser can do everything the product needs, build a web app. No store review, no install, and updates reach everyone at once.

slides.title: Signs you need an installed app
slides.body: Daily camera or location use, work without a signal, notifications people rely on, or customers who expect you in the app stores.

slides.title: Web push needs the home screen
slides.body: On iPhone, a web app can send push notifications only after someone adds it to the home screen. Most people never do.

slides.title: Need an app? Build it once
slides.body: React Native or Flutter shares the business rules and data handling across iOS and Android, so one team maintains one codebase.

slides.title: Go native only where it counts
slides.body: One native-only requirement rarely justifies two codebases. A small native module covers it and the rest stays shared.
